summary: Only the places of T ∖ S matter; they are new places w_j or their conjugates, where vanishing at the tame generator on the right side forces vanishing on inertia.

steps.claim: By selmerModule_mono (same relations L) it suffices that c vanishes on the inertia above each place v ∈ T ∖ S.
Such a v is w_j or w̄_j for some j (T ⊆ S ∪ range w ∪ its conjugate).
